1	from __future__ import annotations
2	
3	import json
4	import sqlite3
5	from contextlib import contextmanager
6	from datetime import datetime, timezone
7	from pathlib import Path
8	from typing import Any, Iterator
9	
10	
11	class Store:
12	    def __init__(self, path: str):
13	        Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
14	        self.connection = sqlite3.connect(path, isolation_level=None, check_same_thread=False)
15	        self.connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
16	        self.connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
17	        self.connection.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
18	        self.connection.executescript(
19	            """
20	            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflows (
21	              id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
22	              document TEXT NOT NULL
23	            );
24	            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS executions (
25	              id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
26	              workflow_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflows(id),
27	              state TEXT NOT NULL
28	            );
29	            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
30	              execution_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES executions(id),
31	              sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
32	              type TEXT NOT NULL,
33	              payload TEXT NOT NULL,
34	              occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
35	              PRIMARY KEY (execution_id, sequence)
36	            );
37	            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency (
38	              key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
39	              operation TEXT NOT NULL,
40	              response TEXT NOT NULL
41	            );
42	            """
43	        )
44	
45	    @contextmanager
46	    def transaction(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
47	        self.connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
48	        try:
49	            yield self.connection
50	        except Exception:
51	            self.connection.execute("ROLLBACK")
52	            raise
53	        else:
54	            self.connection.execute("COMMIT")
55	
56	    @staticmethod
57	    def encode(value: Any) -> str:
58	        return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
59	
60	    @staticmethod
61	    def decode(value: str) -> Any:
62	        return json.loads(value)
63	
64	    @staticmethod
65	    def now() -> str:
66	        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

3	import argparse

5	from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
6	from typing import Any
7	from urllib.parse import urlsplit
8	
9	from .errors import ChronicleFlowError, NotFoundError, ValidationError
10	from .service import ChronicleFlow
11	
12	
13	class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
14	    service: ChronicleFlow
15	
16	    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:
17	        return
18	
19	    def _json(self, status: int, value: Any) -> None:
20	        body = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
21	        self.send_response(status)
22	        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
23	        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
24	        self.end_headers()
25	        self.wfile.write(body)
26	
27	    def _body(self) -> Any:
28	        content_type = self.headers.get("Content-Type", "")
29	        if content_type.split(";", 1)[0].strip().lower() != "application/json":
30	            raise ValidationError("Content-Type must be application/json")
31	        try:
32	            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
33	            if length < 0 or length > 1_000_000:
34	                raise ValueError
35	            return json.loads(self.rfile.read(length))
36	        except (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
37	            raise ValidationError("request body must be valid JSON") from error
38	
39	    def _dispatch(self) -> tuple[int, Any]:
40	        path = urlsplit(self.path).path
41	        parts = [part for part in path.split("/") if part]
42	        if self.command == "GET" and parts == ["health"]:
43	            return 200, {"status": "ok"}
44	        if self.command == "POST" and parts == ["workflows"]:
45	            return 201, self.service.create_workflow(self._body(), self.headers.get("Idempotency-Key"))
46	        if self.command == "POST" and parts == ["executions"]:
47	            return 201, self.service.create_execution(self._body(), self.headers.get("Idempotency-Key"))
48	        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0] == "executions" and self.command == "GET":
49	            return 200, self.service.get_execution(parts[1])
50	        if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == "executions" and parts[2] == "events" and self.command == "GET":
51	            return 200, {"events": self.service.events(parts[1])}
52	        if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == "executions" and parts[2] == "advance" and self.command == "POST":
53	            return 200, self.service.advance(parts[1], self._body(), self.headers.get("Idempotency-Key"))
54	        if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == "executions" and parts[2] == "replay" and self.command == "POST":
55	            return 200, self.service.replay(parts[1])
56	        raise NotFoundError("route was not found")
57	
58	    def _handle(self) -> None:
59	        try:
60	            status, response = self._dispatch()
61	            self._json(status, response)
62	        except ChronicleFlowError as error:
63	            self._json(error.status, {"error": {"code": error.code, "message": str(error)}})
64	        except Exception:
65	            self._json(500, {"error": {"code": "internal_error", "message": "internal server error"}})
66	
67	    do_GET = _handle
68	    do_POST = _handle
69	
70	
71	def main() -> None:
72	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run the ChronicleFlow HTTP service")
73	    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
74	    parser.add_argument("--port", default=8080, type=int)
75	    parser.add_argument("--database", default="chronicleflow.db")
76	    arguments = parser.parse_args()
77	    Handler.service = ChronicleFlow(arguments.database)
78	    server = ThreadingHTTPServer((arguments.host, arguments.port), Handler)
79	    print(f"ChronicleFlow listening on http://{arguments.host}:{arguments.port}", flush=True)
80	    server.serve_forever()
81	
82	
83	if __name__ == "__main__":
84	    main()

import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from chronicleflow.errors import ConflictError, ValidationError
from chronicleflow.service import ChronicleFlow


class ChronicleFlowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.service = ChronicleFlow(str(Path(self.directory.name) / "test.db"))
        self.workflow = {
            "id": "orders",
            "nodes": [
                {"id": "reserve", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []},
                {"id": "charge", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["reserve"]},
            ],
        }

    def tearDown(self):
        self.directory.cleanup()

    def test_execution_advances_and_replays(self):
        self.service.create_workflow(self.workflow, "w1")
        created = self.service.create_execution({"id": "run-1", "workflow_id": "orders", "input": {"order": 7}}, "e1")
        self.assertEqual("running", created["status"])
        first = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"reservation": 9}}, "a1")
        self.assertEqual(["reserve"], first["completed_nodes"])
        completed = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"charge": "ok"}}, "a2")
        self.assertEqual("completed", completed["status"])
        self.assertEqual({"consistent": True, "execution": completed}, self.service.replay("run-1"))

    def test_idempotent_advance_returns_original_result(self):
        self.service.create_workflow(self.workflow, "w1")
        self.service.create_execution({"id": "run-1", "workflow_id": "orders", "input": {}}, "e1")
        first = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"value": 1}}, "same")
        repeated = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"value": 999}}, "same")
        self.assertEqual(first, repeated)
        self.assertEqual(2, len(self.service.events("run-1")))

    def test_cycle_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, "cycle"):
            self.service.create_workflow(
                {
                    "id": "cyclic",
                    "nodes": [
                        {"id": "a", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["b"]},
                        {"id": "b", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["a"]},
                    ],
                },
                "w1",
            )

    def test_key_cannot_be_reused_for_another_operation(self):
        self.service.create_workflow(self.workflow, "shared")
        with self.assertRaises(ConflictError):
            self.service.create_execution({"id": "run-1", "workflow_id": "orders", "input": {}}, "shared")


class ConditionWorkflowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.service = ChronicleFlow(str(Path(self.directory.name) / "test.db"))
        self.workflow = {
            "id": "approval",
            "nodes": [
                {"id": "collect", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []},
                {"id": "is_vip", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": ["collect"], "path": "customer.vip", "equals": True},
                {
                    "id": "expedite",
                    "kind": "task",
                    "depends_on": ["is_vip"],
                    "run_if": {"condition_id": "is_vip", "expected": True},
                },
                {
                    "id": "standard",
                    "kind": "task",
                    "depends_on": ["is_vip"],
                    "run_if": {"condition_id": "is_vip", "expected": False},
                },
            ],
        }
        self.service.create_workflow(self.workflow, "w1")

    def tearDown(self):
        self.directory.cleanup()

    def start(self, input_data, execution_id="run-1"):
        return self.service.create_execution({"id": execution_id, "workflow_id": "approval", "input": input_data}, f"e-{execution_id}")

    def test_matching_run_if_completes_task_and_skips_other_branch(self):
        self.start({"customer": {"vip": True}})
        self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"collected": 1}}, "a1")
        state = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"fast": True}}, "a2")
        self.assertEqual("completed", state["status"])
        self.assertEqual(["collect", "is_vip", "expedite"], state["completed_nodes"])
        self.assertEqual(["standard"], state["skipped_nodes"])
        self.assertEqual({"is_vip": True}, state["condition_results"])
        self.assertEqual({"collect": {"collected": 1}, "expedite": {"fast": True}}, state["outputs"])
        event_types = [event["type"] for event in self.service.events("run-1")]
        self.assertEqual(
            ["execution_started", "node_completed", "condition_evaluated", "node_skipped", "node_completed", "execution_completed"],
            event_types,
        )
        self.assertEqual({"consistent": True, "execution": state}, self.service.replay("run-1"))

    def test_non_matching_condition_skips_task_and_satisfies_successors(self):
        self.start({"customer": {"vip": False}})
        self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {}}, "a1")
        state = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"slow": True}}, "a2")
        self.assertEqual("completed", state["status"])
        self.assertEqual(["expedite"], state["skipped_nodes"])
        self.assertEqual({"is_vip": False}, state["condition_results"])
        self.assertNotIn("expedite", state["outputs"])
        self.assertEqual({"slow": True}, state["outputs"]["standard"])

    def test_missing_path_evaluates_to_false(self):
        self.start({"customer": {}})
        self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {}}, "a1")
        state = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {}}, "a2")
        self.assertEqual({"is_vip": False}, state["condition_results"])
        self.assertEqual(["expedite"], state["skipped_nodes"])

    def test_equals_compares_json_type_and_value(self):
        workflow = {
            "id": "typed",
            "nodes": [
                {"id": "flag", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "flag", "equals": 1},
                {"id": "act", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["flag"], "run_if": {"condition_id": "flag", "expected": True}},
            ],
        }
        self.service.create_workflow(workflow, "w-typed")
        # boolean true is not the JSON number 1, so the condition is false
        self.service.create_execution({"id": "run-t", "workflow_id": "typed", "input": {"flag": True}}, "e-t")
        state = self.service.advance("run-t", {"output": {"ignored": True}}, "a-t")
        self.assertEqual("completed", state["status"])
        self.assertEqual({"flag": False}, state["condition_results"])
        self.assertEqual(["act"], state["skipped_nodes"])
        self.assertEqual({}, state["outputs"])

    def test_auto_processing_completion_returns_state_without_consuming_output(self):
        self.start({"customer": {"vip": False}})
        self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {}}, "a1")
        state = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"slow": True}}, "a2")
        self.assertEqual("completed", state["status"])
        again = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"extra": 1}}, "a3")
        self.assertEqual(state, again)
        self.assertEqual(6, len(self.service.events("run-1")))

    def test_condition_only_workflow_completes_during_auto_processing(self):
        workflow = {
            "id": "check",
            "nodes": [{"id": "c", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "ok", "equals": "yes"}],
        }
        self.service.create_workflow(workflow, "w-check")
        self.service.create_execution({"id": "run-c", "workflow_id": "check", "input": {"ok": "yes"}}, "e-c")
        state = self.service.advance("run-c", {"output": {"never": "used"}}, "a-c")
        self.assertEqual("completed", state["status"])
        self.assertEqual({"c": True}, state["condition_results"])
        self.assertEqual({}, state["outputs"])
        self.assertEqual({"consistent": True, "execution": state}, self.service.replay("run-c"))

    def test_condition_definition_is_round_tripped(self):
        document = dict(self.workflow, id="approval-copy")
        stored = self.service.create_workflow(document, "w-copy")
        self.assertEqual(document, stored)

    def test_invalid_nodes_are_rejected(self):
        base = [{"id": "c", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "a.b", "equals": 1}]
        invalid_workflows = [
            # unknown kind
            [{"id": "x", "kind": "gate", "depends_on": []}],
            # unknown field on a task
            [{"id": "x", "kind": "task", "depends_on": [], "path": "a"}],
            # condition missing equals
            [{"id": "c", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "a"}],
            # condition with run_if
            [dict(base[0], run_if={"condition_id": "c", "expected": True})],
            # empty path
            [dict(base[0], path="")],
            # empty path segment
            [dict(base[0], path="a..b")],
            # non-string path
            [dict(base[0], path=7)],
            # non-scalar equals
            [dict(base[0], equals=[1])],
            [dict(base[0], equals={"a": 1})],
            # run_if expected not boolean
            [{"id": "t", "kind": "task", "depends_on": [], "run_if": {"condition_id": "c", "expected": 1}}] + base,
            # run_if with unknown field
            [
                {"id": "t", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["c"], "run_if": {"condition_id": "c", "expected": True, "x": 1}}
            ]
            + base,
            # run_if referencing a task
            [
                {"id": "a", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []},
                {"id": "b", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["a"], "run_if": {"condition_id": "a", "expected": True}},
            ],
            # run_if referencing an unknown node
            [{"id": "t", "kind": "task", "depends_on": [], "run_if": {"condition_id": "ghost", "expected": True}}],
            # run_if condition not listed in depends_on
            [{"id": "t", "kind": "task", "depends_on": [], "run_if": {"condition_id": "c", "expected": True}}] + base,
        ]
        for index, nodes in enumerate(invalid_workflows):
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
                    self.service.create_workflow({"id": f"bad-{index}", "nodes": nodes}, f"w-bad-{index}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# ChronicleFlow

ChronicleFlow is a small backend for durable workflow orchestration. It stores
workflow definitions, execution state, and an append-only event history in
SQLite so an execution can be inspected and replayed deterministically.

The initial release intentionally supports a compact public contract:

- workflows are directed acyclic graphs of `task` and `condition` nodes, with
  optional bounded `loop` nodes wrapping a task/condition sub-DAG;
- executions advance one ready task at a time, evaluating conditions and
  skipping unmatched branches automatically (including inside loop bodies);
- every state transition is appended to the execution event stream;
- loop state (iteration, per-round results, end reason) is persisted and an
  execution can be resumed or replayed after a process restart;
- replay rebuilds execution state from the recorded events;
- duplicate commands with the same idempotency key return the original result.

# ChronicleFlow

ChronicleFlow is a small backend for durable workflow orchestration. It stores
workflow definitions, execution state, and an append-only event history in
SQLite so an execution can be inspected and replayed deterministically.

The initial release intentionally supports a compact public contract:

- workflows are directed acyclic graphs of `task` and `condition` nodes, with
  optional bounded `loop` nodes wrapping a task/condition sub-DAG;
- executions advance one ready task at a time, evaluating conditions and
  skipping unmatched branches automatically (including inside loop bodies);
- every state transition is appended to the execution event stream;
- loop state (iteration, per-round results, end reason) is persisted and an
  execution can be resumed or replayed after a process restart;
- replay rebuilds execution state from the recorded events;
- duplicate commands with the same idempotency key return the original result.

## Requirements

- Python 3.11 or newer
- no third-party runtime dependencies

## Run the service

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src python -m chronicleflow.server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 --database chronicleflow.db
```

The process prints `ChronicleFlow listening on http://127.0.0.1:8080` after it
has bound the port.

## HTTP API

All request and response bodies are JSON. Unknown fields are rejected.

### Health

```http
GET /health
```

Returns `{"status":"ok"}`.

### Create a workflow

```http
POST /workflows
Idempotency-Key: workflow-request-1

{
  "id": "order-flow",
  "nodes": [
    {"id": "reserve", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []},
    {"id": "charge", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["reserve"]}
  ]
}
```

Returns HTTP 201 with the stored workflow. Node identifiers must be unique,
dependencies must exist, and cycles are rejected.

Besides `task`, a node may have `kind` set to `condition`:

```json
{"id": "is_vip", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": ["reserve"], "path": "customer.vip", "equals": true}
```

`path` is a non-empty dot-separated path into the execution input and `equals`
is a JSON scalar (string, number, boolean, or null). A condition is evaluated
automatically once its dependencies complete: the input value at `path` is
compared with `equals` by JSON type and value, and a missing path evaluates to
`false`.

A task may carry an optional `run_if` guard:

```json
{"id": "expedite", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["is_vip"], "run_if": {"condition_id": "is_vip", "expected": true}}
```

`condition_id` must reference a `condition` node that is also listed in the
task's `depends_on`. When the condition's result differs from `expected`, the
task is marked as skipped: it receives no output and still satisfies the
dependencies of its successors.

### Loops

A third node kind, `loop`, runs a bounded, recoverable sub-DAG of task and
condition nodes:

```json
{
  "id": "retry",
  "kind": "loop",
  "depends_on": ["prepare"],
  "body": ["attempt", "again"],
  "entry": "again",
  "condition_id": "again",
  "max_iterations": 5
}
```

The loop node contains exactly `id`, `kind`, `depends_on`, `body`, `entry`,
`condition_id`, and `max_iterations`. `body` is a non-empty array of node
identifiers with no duplicates; every referenced node must exist, must be a
`task` or `condition` (loops never nest), and may only depend on other body
nodes. `entry` and `condition_id` both name body nodes, and `condition_id`
must reference a `condition`. `max_iterations` is an integer between 1 and
1000. A body node cannot be referenced from outside its loop (successors
depend on the loop node itself), a loop cannot depend on one of its own body
nodes, a node may belong to at most one loop body, `run_if` guards cannot
cross the loop boundary, and cycles inside a body are rejected the same way
as outer cycles.

When the loop's dependencies complete, the control condition is judged
against the execution input. A `false` judgment finishes the loop with zero
iterations and reason `condition_false`. A `true` judgment starts a new
iteration: the body runs as an ordinary DAG, completing the lexicographically
first ready task per `advance` call, auto-evaluating conditions and skipping
`run_if` branches deterministically. When the whole body is settled, the
control condition is judged again; `false` ends the loop with
`condition_false`, a `true` judgment at `max_iterations` ends it with
`iteration_limit`, and otherwise the next iteration begins.

A loop is only added to `completed_nodes` (and therefore satisfies its
successors) once the whole loop has finished. Execution state gains a `loops`
map keyed by loop node id:

```json
{
  "status": "completed",
  "current_iteration": 2,
  "reason": "condition_false",
  "iterations": [
    {"iteration": 1, "completed_nodes": ["attempt", "again"],
     "skipped_nodes": [], "condition_results": {"again": true}}
  ]
}
```

Body tasks store their outputs under `outputs` as an array ordered by
iteration, and body conditions store one boolean per evaluation in
`condition_results`. Body node ids never appear in the top-level
`completed_nodes` / `skipped_nodes` lists; the per-iteration records carry
them instead.

The event stream records the whole loop lifecycle so state can be rebuilt
from events alone: `loop_started`, `loop_condition_evaluated` (with
`phase` `entry` or `between`), `iteration_started`, body-level
`condition_evaluated`, `node_completed`, and `node_skipped` events (each
tagged with `loop_id` and `iteration`), `iteration_completed`, and
`loop_completed` (with `reason` and the number of iterations).

### Start an execution

```http
POST /executions
Idempotency-Key: execution-request-1

{"id":"run-1","workflow_id":"order-flow","input":{"order_id":"o-7"}}
```

Returns HTTP 201. The execution starts in `running` state.

### Inspect an execution

```http
GET /executions/run-1
GET /executions/run-1/events
```

The first endpoint returns the materialized state. The second returns the
ordered event stream.

### Complete the next ready node

```http
POST /executions/run-1/advance
Idempotency-Key: advance-request-1

{"output":{"reservation_id":"r-9"}}
```

The lexicographically first ready task is completed. The response contains the
updated execution. Before that, each call first evaluates all ready conditions
in deterministic order and skips tasks whose `run_if` does not match; if this
automatic processing finishes the execution, the current state is returned and
the submitted output is not consumed. When every node is completed or skipped,
the status becomes `completed`.

The same ordering applies across loop bodies: tasks inside a running loop
iteration and outer tasks share one global lexicographic ordering, so the
smallest ready node id wins wherever it lives. Ending a loop (zero
iterations, or `condition_false`/`iteration_limit` after a round) happens
during automatic processing, so the submitted output is not consumed in that
call; an `advance` against a finished execution returns its stored terminal
state.

Execution state includes `completed_nodes` (which also lists evaluated
conditions), `skipped_nodes`, `condition_results`, and `outputs`. Each
condition evaluation appends a `condition_evaluated` event and each skip a
`node_skipped` event to the execution stream.

### Replay

```http
POST /executions/run-1/replay
```

Rebuilds state solely from the execution event stream and compares it with the
stored materialized state. A successful response contains `consistent: true`
and the rebuilt execution.

## Errors

Errors use this shape:

```json
{"error":{"code":"validation_error","message":"human readable detail"}}
```

Validation errors return 400, missing resources return 404, and conflicts
return 409.

## Tests

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

A third node kind, `loop`, describes a bounded, replayable loop over a body of
tasks and conditions:

```json
{"id": "retry", "kind": "loop", "depends_on": ["prepare"],
 "body_entry": "call", "continue_condition_id": "should_retry", "max_iterations": 5}
```

A loop has exactly `id`, `kind`, `depends_on`, `body_entry`,
`continue_condition_id`, and `max_iterations`. `body_entry` names the first
`task` of the body, `continue_condition_id` names the `condition` that gates
continuation, and `max_iterations` is an integer between 1 and 1000. Tasks and
conditions join a body with an optional `loop_id` that references the loop.

Loop structure is validated when the workflow is created:

- `loop_id`, `body_entry`, and `continue_condition_id` must reference existing
  nodes of the right kind;
- the body must be non-empty, the entry must have no predecessor inside the
  body, and every member must be reachable from the entry through in-body
  dependencies;
- the continue condition must itself be a member;
- loops cannot be nested or share members, and no dependency may cross a loop
  boundary: members may only depend on members of the same loop, loop nodes may
  not depend on members, and nodes outside a loop may not depend on its members.

Once all of a loop's dependencies are satisfied, the continue condition is
evaluated first. If it is `false`, the body never runs: the loop completes
after zero iterations with reason `condition_false`. If it is `true`, the first
iteration starts. Within each iteration, conditions are evaluated and `run_if`
guards skip tasks exactly as at the top level, advancing lexicographically
among ready body tasks. When every member has completed or been skipped, the
continue condition is re-evaluated: if it is `true` and the iteration count is
below `max_iterations` another iteration begins; otherwise the loop completes
with reason `condition_false` or `max_iterations`, and nodes depending on the
loop unblock.

### Start an execution

```http
POST /executions
Idempotency-Key: execution-request-1

{"id":"run-1","workflow_id":"order-flow","input":{"order_id":"o-7"}}
```

Returns HTTP 201. The execution starts in `running` state.

### Inspect an execution

```http
GET /executions/run-1
GET /executions/run-1/events
```

The first endpoint returns the materialized state. The second returns the
ordered event stream.

### Complete the next ready node

```http
POST /executions/run-1/advance
Idempotency-Key: advance-request-1

{"output":{"reservation_id":"r-9"}}
```

The lexicographically first ready task is completed. The response contains the
updated execution. Before that, each call first evaluates all ready conditions
in deterministic order and skips tasks whose `run_if` does not match; if this
automatic processing finishes the execution, the current state is returned and
the submitted output is not consumed. Each call consumes exactly one task
output; automatic processing (including condition evaluation, loop gating, and
iteration bookkeeping) never consumes it. When every node is completed or
skipped, the status becomes `completed`.

Execution state includes `completed_nodes` (which also lists evaluated
conditions), `skipped_nodes`, `condition_results`, `outputs`, and `loops`.

A third node kind, `loop`, describes a bounded, replayable loop over a body of
tasks and conditions:

```json
{"id": "retry", "kind": "loop", "depends_on": ["prepare"],
 "body_entry": "call", "continue_condition_id": "should_retry", "max_iterations": 5}
```

A loop has exactly `id`, `kind`, `depends_on`, `body_entry`,
`continue_condition_id`, and `max_iterations`. `body_entry` names the first
`task` of the body, `continue_condition_id` names the `condition` that gates
continuation, and `max_iterations` is an integer between 1 and 1000. Tasks and
conditions join a body with an optional `loop_id` that references the loop.

Loop structure is validated when the workflow is created:

- `loop_id`, `body_entry`, and `continue_condition_id` must reference existing
  nodes of the right kind;
- the body must be non-empty, the entry must have no predecessor inside the
  body, and every member must be reachable from the entry through in-body
  dependencies;
- the continue condition must itself be a member;
- loops cannot be nested or share members, and no dependency may cross a loop
  boundary: members may only depend on members of the same loop, loop nodes may
  not depend on members, and nodes outside a loop may not depend on its members.

Once all of a loop's dependencies are satisfied, the continue condition is
evaluated first. If it is `false`, the body never runs: the loop completes
after zero iterations with reason `condition_false`. If it is `true`, the first
iteration starts. Within each iteration, conditions are evaluated and `run_if`
guards skip tasks exactly as at the top level, advancing lexicographically
among ready body tasks. When every member has completed or been skipped, the
continue condition is re-evaluated: if it is `true` and the iteration count is
below `max_iterations` another iteration begins; otherwise the loop completes
with reason `condition_false` or `max_iterations`, and nodes depending on the
loop unblock.

23	    current = input_data
24	    for segment in node.path.split("."):
25	        if not isinstance(current, dict) or segment not in current:
26	            return False

28	    return _json_type(current) == _json_type(node.equals) and current == node.equals

31	class ChronicleFlow:
32	    def __init__(self, database: str):
33	        self.store = Store(database)
34	
35	    def _idempotent(self, key: str | None, operation: str, action: Callable[[], dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
36	        if not key:
37	            raise ValidationError("Idempotency-Key header is required")
38	        with self.store.transaction() as connection:
39	            existing = connection.execute("SELECT operation, response FROM idempotency WHERE key = ?", (key,)).fetchone()
40	            if existing:
41	                if existing["operation"] != operation:
42	                    raise ConflictError("idempotency key was already used for another operation")
43	                return self.store.decode(existing["response"])
44	            response = action()
45	            connection.execute(
46	                "INSERT INTO idempotency(key, operation, response) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
47	                (key, operation, self.store.encode(response)),
48	            )
49	            return response
50	
51	    def create_workflow(self, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
52	        workflow = Workflow.parse(raw)
53	
54	        def create() -> dict[str, Any]:
55	            try:
56	                self.store.connection.execute(
57	                    "INSERT INTO workflows(id, document) VALUES (?, ?)",
58	                    (workflow.id, self.store.encode(workflow.as_dict())),
59	                )
60	            except Exception as error:
61	                if "UNIQUE constraint" in str(error):
62	                    raise ConflictError(f"workflow {workflow.id} already exists") from error
63	                raise
64	            return workflow.as_dict()
65	
66	        return self._idempotent(key, f"create-workflow:{workflow.id}", create)
67	
68	    def create_execution(self, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
69	        if not isinstance(raw, dict) or set(raw) != {"id", "workflow_id", "input"}:
70	            raise ValidationError("execution must contain exactly id, workflow_id, and input")
71	        execution_id = _identifier(raw["id"], "execution id")
72	        workflow_id = _identifier(raw["workflow_id"], "workflow id")
73	        if not isinstance(raw["input"], dict):
74	            raise ValidationError("input must be an object")
75	
76	        def create() -> dict[str, Any]:
77	            workflow_row = self.store.connection.execute("SELECT document FROM workflows WHERE id = ?", (workflow_id,)).fetchone()
78	            if not workflow_row:
79	                raise NotFoundError(f"workflow {workflow_id} was not found")
80	            workflow = Workflow.parse(self.store.decode(workflow_row["document"]))
81	            state = self._initial_state(execution_id, workflow_id, raw["input"], workflow)
82	            try:
83	                self.store.connection.execute(
84	                    "INSERT INTO executions(id, workflow_id, state) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
85	                    (execution_id, workflow_id, self.store.encode(state)),
86	                )
87	            except Exception as error:
88	                if "UNIQUE constraint" in str(error):
89	                    raise ConflictError(f"execution {execution_id} already exists") from error
90	                raise
91	            self._append(
92	                execution_id,
93	                "execution_started",
94	                {
95	                    "workflow_id": workflow_id,
96	                    "input": raw["input"],
97	                    "loops": [loop.id for loop in workflow.nodes if loop.kind == "loop"],
98	                },
99	            )
100	            return state
101	
102	        return self._idempotent(key, f"create-execution:{execution_id}", create)
103	
104	    @staticmethod
105	    def _initial_state(execution_id: str, workflow_id: str, input_data: dict[str, Any], workflow: Workflow) -> dict[str, Any]:
106	        return {
107	            "id": execution_id,
108	            "workflow_id": workflow_id,
109	            "status": "running",
110	            "input": input_data,
111	            "completed_nodes": [],
112	            "skipped_nodes": [],
113	            "condition_results": {},
114	            "outputs": {},
115	            "loops": {
116	                loop.id: {
117	                    "status": "waiting",
118	                    "current_iteration": 0,
119	                    "reason": None,
120	                    "iterations": [],
121	                }
122	                for loop in workflow.nodes
123	                if loop.kind == "loop"
124	            },
125	        }
126	
127	    def get_execution(self, execution_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
128	        row = self.store.connection.execute("SELECT state FROM executions WHERE id = ?", (execution_id,)).fetchone()
129	        if not row:
130	            raise NotFoundError(f"execution {execution_id} was not found")
131	        return self.store.decode(row["state"])
132	
133	    def events(self, execution_id: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
134	        self.get_execution(execution_id)
135	        rows = self.store.connection.execute(
136	            "SELECT sequence, type, payload, occurred_at FROM events WHERE execution_id = ? ORDER BY sequence",
137	            (execution_id,),
138	        ).fetchall()
139	        return [
140	            {"sequence": row["sequence"], "type": row["type"], "payload": self.store.decode(row["payload"]), "occurred_at": row["occurred_at"]}
141	            for row in rows

144	    def advance(self, execution_id: str, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
145	        if not isinstance(raw, dict) or set(raw) != {"output"} or not isinstance(raw["output"], dict):
146	            raise ValidationError("advance body must contain exactly an output object")
147	
148	        def apply() -> dict[str, Any]:
149	            state = self.get_execution(execution_id)
150	            if state["status"] != "running":
151	                return state
152	            workflow_row = self.store.connection.execute("SELECT document FROM workflows WHERE id = ?", (state["workflow_id"],)).fetchone()
153	            workflow = Workflow.parse(self.store.decode(workflow_row["document"]))
154	            engine = _Engine(self, execution_id, workflow, state)
155	            engine.auto_process()
156	            if state["status"] == "running":
157	                ready = engine.ready_tasks()
158	                if not ready:
159	                    raise ConflictError("execution has no ready node")
160	                node_id, iteration = ready[0]
161	                engine.complete_task(node_id, iteration, raw["output"])
162	                engine.auto_process()
163	            self.store.connection.execute("UPDATE executions SET state = ? WHERE id = ?", (self.store.encode(state), execution_id))
164	            return state

170	        rebuilt: dict[str, Any] | None = None
171	        loops_state: dict[str, Any] = {}

173	        def iteration_record(loop_id: str, iteration: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
174	            record = loops_state[loop_id]
175	            while len(record["iterations"]) < iteration:
176	                record["iterations"].append(
177	                    {
178	                        "iteration": len(record["iterations"]) + 1,
179	                        "completed_nodes": [],
180	                        "skipped_nodes": [],
181	                        "condition_results": {},
182	                    }
183	                )
184	            return record["iterations"][iteration - 1]

186	        for event in self.events(execution_id):

191	                    for loop_id in payload.get("loops", [])
192	                }

201	                    "outputs": {},
202	                    "loops": loops_state,
203	                }

208	                node_id = payload["node_id"]
209	                if "loop_id" in payload:
210	                    entry = iteration_record(payload["loop_id"], payload["iteration"])
211	                    entry["condition_results"][node_id] = payload["result"]
212	                    entry["completed_nodes"].append(node_id)
213	                    rebuilt["condition_results"].setdefault(node_id, []).append(payload["result"])
214	                else:
215	                    rebuilt["condition_results"][node_id] = payload["result"]
216	                    rebuilt["completed_nodes"].append(node_id)
217	            elif event["type"] == "node_skipped":
218	                if "loop_id" in payload:
219	                    iteration_record(payload["loop_id"], payload["iteration"])["skipped_nodes"].append(payload["node_id"])
220	                else:
221	                    rebuilt["skipped_nodes"].append(payload["node_id"])
222	            elif event["type"] == "node_completed":
223	                if "loop_id" in payload:
224	                    entry = iteration_record(payload["loop_id"], payload["iteration"])
225	                    entry["completed_nodes"].append(payload["node_id"])
226	                    rebuilt["outputs"].setdefault(payload["node_id"], []).append(payload["output"])
227	                else:

229	                    rebuilt["outputs"][payload["node_id"]] = payload["output"]
230	            elif event["type"] == "loop_started":

232	            elif event["type"] == "iteration_started":
233	                record = loops_state[payload["loop_id"]]

259	class _Engine:
260	    """Materializes workflow state transitions and records them as events.
261	
262	    Loop event protocol (all payloads carry loop_id):
263	
264	    - loop_started {} then loop_condition_evaluated {phase:"entry",result}
265	    - on a true judgment: iteration_started {iteration}
266	    - body node events carry iteration; iteration_completed {iteration}
267	    - loop_condition_evaluated {phase:"between",iteration,result}
268	    - loop_completed {reason,iterations} where reason is condition_false
269	      or iteration_limit
270	    """
271	
272	    def __init__(self, service: ChronicleFlow, execution_id: str, workflow: Workflow, state: dict[str, Any]):
273	        self.service = service
274	        self.execution_id = execution_id
275	        self.workflow = workflow
276	        self.state = state
277	        self.by_id = {node.id: node for node in workflow.nodes}
278	        self.loops = sorted((node for node in workflow.nodes if node.kind == "loop"), key=lambda node: node.id)
279	        self.loop_owners = {
280	            member_id: loop.id for loop in self.loops for member_id in loop.body
281	        }
282	
283	    def append(self, event_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
284	        self.service._append(self.execution_id, event_type, payload)
285	
286	    def loop_record(self, loop_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
287	        return self.state["loops"][loop_id]
288	
289	    def iteration_entry(self, loop_id: str, iteration: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
290	        return self.loop_record(loop_id)["iterations"][iteration - 1]
291	
292	    def is_finished(self, node_id: str, iteration: int | None = None) -> bool:
293	        owner = self.loop_owners.get(node_id)
294	        if owner is None:
295	            return node_id in self.state["completed_nodes"] or node_id in self.state["skipped_nodes"]
296	        record = self.loop_record(owner)
297	        if record["status"] != "running" or record["current_iteration"] != iteration:
298	            return False
299	        entry = record["iterations"][iteration - 1]
300	        return node_id in entry["completed_nodes"] or node_id in entry["skipped_nodes"]
301	
302	    def dependencies_satisfied(self, node: Node, iteration: int | None) -> bool:
303	        for dependency_id in node.depends_on:
304	            if self.loop_owners.get(dependency_id) == self.loop_owners.get(node.id):
305	                if not self.is_finished(dependency_id, iteration):
306	                    return False
307	            elif dependency_id not in self.state["completed_nodes"] and dependency_id not in self.state["skipped_nodes"]:
308	                return False
309	        return True
310	
311	    def condition_value(self, condition_id: str, iteration: int | None) -> bool:
312	        results = self.state["condition_results"][condition_id]
313	        return results if iteration is None else results[iteration - 1]
314	
315	    # -- outer DAG --------------------------------------------------------
316	
317	    def evaluate_outer_condition(self, node: Node) -> bool:
318	        if self.is_finished(node.id) or not self.dependencies_satisfied(node, None):
319	            return False
320	        result = _evaluate_condition(node, self.state["input"])
321	        self.state["condition_results"][node.id] = result
322	        self.state["completed_nodes"].append(node.id)
323	        self.append("condition_evaluated", {"node_id": node.id, "result": result})
324	        return True
325	
326	    def skip_outer_task_if_guarded(self, node: Node) -> bool:
327	        if node.run_if is None or self.is_finished(node.id) or not self.dependencies_satisfied(node, None):
328	            return False
329	        if self.condition_value(node.run_if.condition_id, None) == node.run_if.expected:
330	            return False
331	        self.state["skipped_nodes"].append(node.id)
332	        self.append("node_skipped", {"node_id": node.id})
333	        return True
334	
335	    # -- loops ------------------------------------------------------------
336	
337	    def ready_loops(self) -> list[Node]:
338	        settled = set(self.state["completed_nodes"]) | set(self.state["skipped_nodes"])
339	        return [
340	            loop
341	            for loop in self.loops
342	            if self.loop_record(loop.id)["status"] == "waiting" and set(loop.depends_on) <= settled
343	        ]
344	
345	    def start_loop(self, loop: Node) -> None:
346	        record = self.loop_record(loop.id)
347	        record["status"] = "running"
348	        self.append("loop_started", {"loop_id": loop.id})
349	        result = _evaluate_condition(self.by_id[loop.condition_id], self.state["input"])
350	        self.append(
351	            "loop_condition_evaluated",
352	            {"loop_id": loop.id, "condition_id": loop.condition_id, "phase": "entry", "result": result},
353	        )
354	        if result is False:
355	            self.finish_loop(loop, "condition_false")
356	        else:
357	            self.start_iteration(loop, 1)
358	
359	    def start_iteration(self, loop: Node, iteration: int) -> None:
360	        record = self.loop_record(loop.id)
361	        record["current_iteration"] = iteration
362	        record["iterations"].append(
363	            {"iteration": iteration, "completed_nodes": [], "skipped_nodes": [], "condition_results": {}}
364	        )
365	        self.append("iteration_started", {"loop_id": loop.id, "iteration": iteration})
366	
367	    def finish_loop(self, loop: Node, reason: str) -> None:
368	        record = self.loop_record(loop.id)
369	        record["status"] = "completed"
370	        record["reason"] = reason
371	        record["current_iteration"] = len(record["iterations"])
372	        self.state["completed_nodes"].append(loop.id)
373	        self.append(
374	            "loop_completed",
375	            {"loop_id": loop.id, "reason": reason, "iterations": len(record["iterations"])},
376	        )
377	
378	    def evaluate_body_condition(self, loop: Node, iteration: int, node: Node) -> bool:
379	        if self.is_finished(node.id, iteration) or not self.dependencies_satisfied(node, iteration):
380	            return False
381	        result = _evaluate_condition(node, self.state["input"])
382	        entry = self.iteration_entry(loop.id, iteration)
383	        entry["condition_results"][node.id] = result
384	        self.state["condition_results"].setdefault(node.id, []).append(result)
385	        entry["completed_nodes"].append(node.id)
386	        self.append(
387	            "condition_evaluated",
388	            {"loop_id": loop.id, "iteration": iteration, "node_id": node.id, "result": result},
389	        )
390	        return True
391	
392	    def skip_body_task_if_guarded(self, loop: Node, iteration: int, node: Node) -> bool:
393	        if node.run_if is None or self.is_finished(node.id, iteration) or not self.dependencies_satisfied(node, iteration):
394	            return False
395	        if self.condition_value(node.run_if.condition_id, iteration) == node.run_if.expected:
396	            return False
397	        self.iteration_entry(loop.id, iteration)["skipped_nodes"].append(node.id)
398	        self.append(
399	            "node_skipped",
400	            {"loop_id": loop.id, "iteration": iteration, "node_id": node.id},
401	        )
402	        return True
403	
404	    def complete_task(self, node_id: str, iteration: int | None, output: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
405	        if iteration is None:
406	            self.state["completed_nodes"].append(node_id)
407	            self.state["outputs"][node_id] = output
408	            self.append("node_completed", {"node_id": node_id, "output": output})
409	            return
410	        owner = self.loop_owners[node_id]
411	        self.iteration_entry(owner, iteration)["completed_nodes"].append(node_id)
412	        self.state["outputs"].setdefault(node_id, []).append(output)
413	        self.append(
414	            "node_completed",
415	            {"loop_id": owner, "iteration": iteration, "node_id": node_id, "output": output},
416	        )
417	
418	    def settle_iteration(self, loop: Node, iteration: int) -> bool:
419	        """Auto-evaluate conditions and skip guarded tasks inside one round."""
420	        progressed = False
421	        changed = True
422	        while changed:
423	            changed = False
424	            for member_id in sorted(loop.body):
425	                node = self.by_id[member_id]
426	                if self.is_finished(member_id, iteration):
427	                    continue
428	                if node.kind == "condition":
429	                    if self.evaluate_body_condition(loop, iteration, node):
430	                        changed = True
431	                        progressed = True
432	                elif self.skip_body_task_if_guarded(loop, iteration, node):
433	                    changed = True
434	                    progressed = True
435	        return progressed
436	
437	    def close_iteration_if_done(self, loop: Node) -> bool:
438	        """Finish a round whose whole body is settled. Returns progress flag."""
439	        record = self.loop_record(loop.id)
440	        if record["status"] != "running":
441	            return False
442	        iteration = record["current_iteration"]
443	        entry = record["iterations"][iteration - 1]
444	        done = set(entry["completed_nodes"]) | set(entry["skipped_nodes"])
445	        if not set(loop.body) <= done:
446	            return False
447	        self.append("iteration_completed", {"loop_id": loop.id, "iteration": iteration})
448	        # The control condition is a body node, so it was auto-evaluated while
449	        # the round was settled; the round-end judgment reuses that result.
450	        result = entry["condition_results"][loop.condition_id]
451	        self.append(
452	            "loop_condition_evaluated",
453	            {
454	                "loop_id": loop.id,
455	                "condition_id": loop.condition_id,
456	                "phase": "between",
457	                "iteration": iteration,
458	                "result": result,
459	            },
460	        )
461	        if result is False:
462	            self.finish_loop(loop, "condition_false")
463	        elif iteration >= loop.max_iterations:
464	            self.finish_loop(loop, "iteration_limit")
465	        else:
466	            self.start_iteration(loop, iteration + 1)
467	        return True
468	
469	    # -- main fixed point -------------------------------------------------
470	
471	    def auto_process(self) -> None:
472	        outer_conditions = sorted(
473	            (node for node in self.workflow.nodes if node.kind == "condition" and node.id not in self.loop_owners),
474	            key=lambda node: node.id,
475	        )
476	        outer_tasks = sorted(
477	            (node for node in self.workflow.nodes if node.kind == "task" and node.id not in self.loop_owners),
478	            key=lambda node: node.id,
479	        )
480	        progressed = True
481	        while progressed:
482	            progressed = False
483	            for loop in self.ready_loops():
484	                self.start_loop(loop)
485	                progressed = True
486	            for loop in self.loops:
487	                record = self.loop_record(loop.id)
488	                if record["status"] != "running":
489	                    continue
490	                iteration = record["current_iteration"]
491	                if self.settle_iteration(loop, iteration):
492	                    progressed = True
493	                if self.close_iteration_if_done(loop):
494	                    progressed = True
495	            for node in outer_conditions:
496	                if self.evaluate_outer_condition(node):
497	                    progressed = True
498	            for node in outer_tasks:
499	                if self.skip_outer_task_if_guarded(node):
500	                    progressed = True
501	        # Body nodes are encapsulated by their loop: they only appear in the
502	        # per-iteration records, never in the top-level lists.
503	        total = len(self.workflow.nodes) - len(self.loop_owners)
504	        if len(self.state["completed_nodes"]) + len(self.state["skipped_nodes"]) == total:
505	            if self.state["status"] == "running":
506	                self.state["status"] = "completed"
507	                self.append("execution_completed", {})
508	
509	    def ready_tasks(self) -> list[tuple[str, int | None]]:
510	        """All ready tasks, lexicographically smallest node id first."""
511	        ready: list[tuple[str, int | None]] = []
512	        for loop in self.loops:
513	            record = self.loop_record(loop.id)
514	            if record["status"] != "running":
515	                continue
516	            iteration = record["current_iteration"]
517	            for member_id in loop.body:
518	                node = self.by_id[member_id]
519	                if (
520	                    node.kind == "task"
521	                    and not self.is_finished(member_id, iteration)
522	                    and self.dependencies_satisfied(node, iteration)
523	                ):
524	                    ready.append((member_id, iteration))
525	        for node in self.workflow.nodes:
526	            if node.kind == "task" and node.id not in self.loop_owners:
527	                if not self.is_finished(node.id) and self.dependencies_satisfied(node, None):
528	                    ready.append((node.id, None))
529	        ready.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
530	        return ready

import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from chronicleflow.errors import ConflictError, ValidationError
from chronicleflow.service import ChronicleFlow


class ChronicleFlowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.service = ChronicleFlow(str(Path(self.directory.name) / "test.db"))
        self.workflow = {
            "id": "orders",
            "nodes": [
                {"id": "reserve", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []},
                {"id": "charge", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["reserve"]},
            ],
        }

    def tearDown(self):
        self.directory.cleanup()

    def test_execution_advances_and_replays(self):
        self.service.create_workflow(self.workflow, "w1")
        created = self.service.create_execution({"id": "run-1", "workflow_id": "orders", "input": {"order": 7}}, "e1")
        self.assertEqual("running", created["status"])
        first = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"reservation": 9}}, "a1")
        self.assertEqual(["reserve"], first["completed_nodes"])
        completed = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"charge": "ok"}}, "a2")
        self.assertEqual("completed", completed["status"])
        self.assertEqual({"consistent": True, "execution": completed}, self.service.replay("run-1"))

    def test_idempotent_advance_returns_original_result(self):
        self.service.create_workflow(self.workflow, "w1")
        self.service.create_execution({"id": "run-1", "workflow_id": "orders", "input": {}}, "e1")
        first = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"value": 1}}, "same")
        repeated = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"value": 999}}, "same")
        self.assertEqual(first, repeated)
        self.assertEqual(2, len(self.service.events("run-1")))

    def test_cycle_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, "cycle"):
            self.service.create_workflow(
                {
                    "id": "cyclic",
                    "nodes": [
                        {"id": "a", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["b"]},
                        {"id": "b", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["a"]},
                    ],
                },
                "w1",
            )

    def test_key_cannot_be_reused_for_another_operation(self):
        self.service.create_workflow(self.workflow, "shared")
        with self.assertRaises(ConflictError):

class LoopWorkflowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.db_path = str(Path(self.directory.name) / "test.db")
        self.service = ChronicleFlow(self.db_path)
        # retry loop: attempt runs every round, "again" is both entry and
        # control condition and depends on attempt.
        self.workflow = {
            "id": "retries",
            "nodes": [
                {"id": "prepare", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []},
                {"id": "attempt", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []},
                {"id": "again", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": ["attempt"], "path": "keep", "equals": True},
                {
                    "id": "retry",
                    "kind": "loop",
                    "depends_on": ["prepare"],
                    "body": ["attempt", "again"],
                    "entry": "again",
                    "condition_id": "again",
                    "max_iterations": 3,
                },
                {"id": "report", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["retry"]},
            ],
        }
        self.service.create_workflow(self.workflow, "w1")

    def tearDown(self):
        self.directory.cleanup()

    def start(self, input_data, execution_id="run-1"):
        return self.service.create_execution(
            {"id": execution_id, "workflow_id": "retries", "input": input_data}, f"e-{execution_id}"
        )

    def advance(self, key_index, output=None):
        return self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": output if output is not None else {"n": key_index}}, f"a{key_index}")

    def test_false_entry_judgment_runs_zero_iterations(self):
        self.start({"keep": False})
        state = self.advance(1)
        # prepare completed; the loop auto-ended with zero iterations, leaving
        # report as the only remaining ready task
        self.assertEqual("running", state["status"])
        loop = state["loops"]["retry"]
        self.assertEqual("condition_false", loop["reason"])
        self.assertEqual(0, loop["current_iteration"])
        self.assertEqual([], loop["iterations"])
        self.assertEqual(["prepare", "retry"], state["completed_nodes"])
        self.assertNotIn("attempt", state["outputs"])
        state = self.advance(2)
        self.assertEqual("completed", state["status"])
        # body nodes are encapsulated: only prepare, the loop, and report ran
        self.assertEqual(["prepare", "retry", "report"], state["completed_nodes"])
        self.assertEqual({"n": 1}, state["outputs"]["prepare"])
        self.assertEqual({"n": 2}, state["outputs"]["report"])
        event_types = [event["type"] for event in self.service.events("run-1")]
        self.assertEqual(
            [
                "execution_started",
                "node_completed",
                "loop_started",
                "loop_condition_evaluated",
                "loop_completed",
                "node_completed",
                "execution_completed",
            ],
            event_types,
        )
        entry_event = self.service.events("run-1")[3]
        self.assertEqual("entry", entry_event["payload"]["phase"])
        self.assertFalse(entry_event["payload"]["result"])
        self.assertEqual({"consistent": True, "execution": state}, self.service.replay("run-1"))

    def test_loop_runs_to_iteration_limit_with_per_iteration_state(self):
        self.start({"keep": True})
        state = None
        for index in range(1, 6):
            state = self.advance(index)
            if state["status"] == "completed":
                break
        self.assertEqual("completed", state["status"])
        loop = state["loops"]["retry"]
        self.assertEqual("iteration_limit", loop["reason"])
        self.assertEqual(3, loop["current_iteration"])
        self.assertEqual([1, 2, 3], [entry["iteration"] for entry in loop["iterations"]])
        for entry in loop["iterations"]:
            self.assertEqual(["attempt", "again"], entry["completed_nodes"])
            self.assertEqual([], entry["skipped_nodes"])
            self.assertEqual({"again": True}, entry["condition_results"])
        self.assertEqual(["prepare", "retry", "report"], state["completed_nodes"])
        # body task outputs accumulate in iteration order
        self.assertEqual([{"n": 2}, {"n": 3}, {"n": 4}], state["outputs"]["attempt"])
        self.assertEqual({"n": 1}, state["outputs"]["prepare"])
        self.assertEqual({"n": 5}, state["outputs"]["report"])
        # one condition result per evaluation, including the between judgments
        self.assertEqual([True, True, True], state["condition_results"]["again"])
        event_types = [event["type"] for event in self.service.events("run-1")]
        self.assertEqual(
            [
                "execution_started",
                "node_completed",
                "loop_started",
                "loop_condition_evaluated",
                "iteration_started",
                "node_completed",
                "condition_evaluated",
                "iteration_completed",
                "loop_condition_evaluated",
                "iteration_started",
                "node_completed",
                "condition_evaluated",
                "iteration_completed",
                "loop_condition_evaluated",
                "iteration_started",
                "node_completed",
                "condition_evaluated",
                "iteration_completed",
                "loop_condition_evaluated",
                "loop_completed",
                "node_completed",
                "execution_completed",
            ],
            event_types,
        )
        between = [event for event in self.service.events("run-1") if event["type"] == "loop_condition_evaluated"]
        self.assertEqual(["entry", "between", "between", "between"], [event["payload"]["phase"] for event in between])
        self.assertEqual({"consistent": True, "execution": state}, self.service.replay("run-1"))

    def test_run_if_branch_is_skipped_inside_each_iteration(self):
        workflow = {
            "id": "branched",
            "nodes": [
                {"id": "switch", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "go", "equals": True},
                {"id": "do", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["switch"],
                 "run_if": {"condition_id": "switch", "expected": True}},
                {"id": "skip_me", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["switch"],
                 "run_if": {"condition_id": "switch", "expected": False}},
                {"id": "again", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": ["do"], "path": "go", "equals": True},
                {"id": "lp", "kind": "loop", "depends_on": [],
                 "body": ["switch", "do", "skip_me", "again"], "entry": "switch",
                 "condition_id": "again", "max_iterations": 2},
            ],
        }
        self.service.create_workflow(workflow, "w2")
        self.service.create_execution({"id": "run-2", "workflow_id": "branched", "input": {"go": True}}, "e2")
        for index in range(1, 4):
            state = self.service.advance("run-2", {"output": {"n": index}}, f"b{index}")
        self.assertEqual("completed", state["status"])
        self.assertEqual("iteration_limit", state["loops"]["lp"]["reason"])
        for entry in state["loops"]["lp"]["iterations"]:
            self.assertEqual(["switch", "do", "again"], entry["completed_nodes"])
            self.assertEqual(["skip_me"], entry["skipped_nodes"])
        self.assertNotIn("skip_me", state["outputs"])
        self.assertEqual([{"n": 1}, {"n": 2}], state["outputs"]["do"])
        self.assertEqual({"consistent": True, "execution": state}, self.service.replay("run-2"))

    def test_global_ready_ordering_mixes_body_and_outer_tasks(self):
        # Both the loop (no dependencies, true entry) and the outer task aaa
        # are immediately available; aaa sorts before the body task bbb.
        workflow = {
            "id": "ordered",
            "nodes": [
                {"id": "bbb", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []},
                {"id": "cond", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": ["bbb"], "path": "go", "equals": True},
                {"id": "lp", "kind": "loop", "depends_on": [],
                 "body": ["bbb", "cond"], "entry": "cond", "condition_id": "cond",
                 "max_iterations": 1},
                {"id": "aaa", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []},
            ],
        }
        self.service.create_workflow(workflow, "w3")
        self.service.create_execution({"id": "run-3", "workflow_id": "ordered", "input": {"go": True}}, "e3")
        state = self.service.advance("run-3", {"output": {"who": "outer"}}, "c1")
        # the loop is already running but the outer task sorts first
        self.assertIn("aaa", state["completed_nodes"])
        self.assertEqual([], state["loops"]["lp"]["iterations"][0]["completed_nodes"])
        state = self.service.advance("run-3", {"output": {"who": "body"}}, "c2")
        self.assertEqual("completed", state["status"])
        self.assertEqual([{"who": "body"}], state["outputs"]["bbb"])
        self.assertEqual({"consistent": True, "execution": state}, self.service.replay("run-3"))

    def test_successor_is_not_ready_until_loop_completes(self):
        self.start({"keep": True})
        self.advance(1)  # prepare -> loop starts
        self.advance(2)  # first attempt
        state = self.service.get_execution("run-1")
        self.assertEqual("running", state["status"])
        self.assertNotIn("retry", state["completed_nodes"])
        self.assertNotIn("report", state["completed_nodes"])

    def test_execution_resumes_mid_loop_from_persisted_state(self):
        self.start({"keep": True})
        self.advance(1)
        state = self.advance(2)  # first iteration done, second is running
        self.assertEqual(2, state["loops"]["retry"]["current_iteration"])
        # simulate a process restart against the same database
        restarted = ChronicleFlow(self.db_path)
        for index in range(3, 6):
            state = restarted.advance("run-1", {"output": {"n": index}}, f"a{index}")
            if state["status"] == "completed":
                break
        self.assertEqual("completed", state["status"])
        self.assertEqual("iteration_limit", state["loops"]["retry"]["reason"])
        self.assertEqual([{"n": 2}, {"n": 3}, {"n": 4}], state["outputs"]["attempt"])
        self.assertEqual({"consistent": True, "execution": state}, restarted.replay("run-1"))

    def test_repeated_idempotency_key_mid_loop_returns_original_result(self):
        self.start({"keep": True})
        self.advance(1)
        first = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"n": 2}}, "shared")
        # completing the first attempt auto-closes the round and starts the next
        self.assertEqual(2, first["loops"]["retry"]["current_iteration"])
        repeated = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"n": 999}}, "shared")
        self.assertEqual(first, repeated)
        self.assertEqual(1, len(first["outputs"]["attempt"]))
        events = self.service.events("run-1")
        self.assertEqual(
            1,
            sum(
                1
                for event in events
                if event["type"] == "node_completed" and event["payload"].get("node_id") == "attempt"
            ),
        )

    def test_terminal_advance_returns_state_without_consuming_output(self):
        self.start({"keep": False})
        self.advance(1)  # prepare, then the loop auto-ends with zero iterations
        state = self.advance(2)  # report
        self.assertEqual("completed", state["status"])
        again = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"extra": True}}, "later")
        self.assertEqual(state, again)
        event_count = len(self.service.events("run-1"))
        self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"extra": True}}, "later")
        self.assertEqual(event_count, len(self.service.events("run-1")))

    def test_loop_definition_is_round_tripped(self):
        document = dict(self.workflow, id="retries-copy")
        stored = self.service.create_workflow(document, "w-copy")
        self.assertEqual(document, stored)

    def test_invalid_loop_definitions_are_rejected(self):
        template = self.workflow

        def loop_doc(mutate, doc_id):
            import copy

            document = copy.deepcopy(template)
            document["id"] = doc_id
            mutate(document["nodes"][3])
            return document

        cases = [
            lambda loop: loop.update(body=["attempt"]),                       # entry/condition out of body
            lambda loop: loop.update(entry="prepare"),                        # entry out of body
            lambda loop: loop.update(body=["attempt", "attempt", "again"]),   # duplicate body id
            lambda loop: loop.update(condition_id="attempt"),                 # condition id is a task
            lambda loop: loop.update(max_iterations=0),
            lambda loop: loop.update(max_iterations=1001),
            lambda loop: loop.update(max_iterations="3"),
            lambda loop: loop.update(max_iterations=True),
            lambda loop: loop.update(unexpected=1),
            lambda loop: loop.pop("entry"),
        ]
        for index, mutate in enumerate(cases):
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
                    self.service.create_workflow(loop_doc(mutate, f"bad-loop-{index}"), f"w-bad-loop-{index}")

    def test_loop_boundary_violations_are_rejected(self):
        import copy

        # body node depending on a node outside the body
        document = copy.deepcopy(self.workflow)
        document["id"] = "boundary-1"
        document["nodes"][1]["depends_on"] = ["prepare"]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, "out-of-body"):
            self.service.create_workflow(document, "wb1")
        # outer node depending on a body member
        document = copy.deepcopy(self.workflow)
        document["id"] = "boundary-2"
        document["nodes"][4]["depends_on"] = ["attempt"]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, "cannot depend on loop body node"):
            self.service.create_workflow(document, "wb2")
        # nested loop
        document = copy.deepcopy(self.workflow)
        document["id"] = "boundary-3"
        document["nodes"][3]["body"] = ["inner"]
        document["nodes"].append(
            {"id": "inner", "kind": "loop", "depends_on": [], "body": ["attempt", "again"],
             "entry": "again", "condition_id": "again", "max_iterations": 1}
        )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, "must not contain another loop"):
            self.service.create_workflow(document, "wb3")
        # dependency cycle inside a body
        document = copy.deepcopy(self.workflow)
        document["id"] = "boundary-4"
        document["nodes"][1]["depends_on"] = ["again"]
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.service.create_workflow(document, "wb4")
        # unknown body reference
        document = copy.deepcopy(self.workflow)
        document["id"] = "boundary-5"
        document["nodes"][3]["body"] = ["ghost"]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, "unknown nodes"):
            self.service.create_workflow(document, "wb5")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

5	SQLite so an execution can be inspected and replayed deterministically.

10	- executions advance one ready task at a time, evaluating conditions and
11	  skipping unmatched branches automatically;

15	- replay rebuilds execution state from the recorded events;
16	- duplicate commands with the same idempotency key return the original result.
17

19	
20	- Python 3.11 or newer
21	- no third-party runtime dependencies
22	
23	## Run the service
24	
25	```bash
26	PYTHONPATH=src python -m chronicleflow.server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 --database chronicleflow.db
27	```
28	
29	The process prints `ChronicleFlow listening on http://127.0.0.1:8080` after it
30	has bound the port.
31
